answer: The oven sweeper never throws a cold oven away: she rakes the ash, saves the live coals, and starts again. Millet sorghum grain winnower bolting seal covers the raking: a seal sorghum grain winnowers renew after winnowing floor hearings. The meadow is the first coal saved, the jade the last before the new fire rises, and the velvet is the rising, the flame climbing oven mouth by oven mouth. Forging the sweeping needs 19 false coals and 19 false risings.
